scenes.supportingCopy: The song appears on the album "Femme Fatale" (2011). "Hold It Against Me" is a song by American singer Britney Spears from her seventh studio album, Femme Fatale (2011). Femme Fatale is the seventh studio album by American singer Britney Spears. It was released on March 25, 2011, by Jive Records, and was her last album with the label before they dissolved in October of the same year, and she was moved to RCA Records. Musically, Spears wanted to make a "fresh-sounding" and "fierce dance album", thus incorporating dance-pop, electropop, EDM and synth-pop styles with elements of dubstep, techno and electro in its sound. Artist: Britney Spears · Title: Hold It Against Me (Promo Only No Break Edit*) · Album: HV 04-11 · Year: 2011 · Genre: Pop · Path: MEDIA/VIDEO/2010's/Britney Spears - Hold It Against Me (Promo Only No Break Edit_).mp4 Britney Jean is the eighth studio album by American singer Britney Spears. The album is Spears's second eponymous record after Britney (2001), though the album's name refers to both her first and middle names.
